description.zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的全球加速实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations.

description.zh: 待查询映射信息配置的终端节点组ID。
description.en: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query destination configurations.

description.zh:
终端节点组后端服务起始端口。

取值范围：**1**~**65499**，且需满足**FromPort**≤**ToPort**，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。
description.en:
The start port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: **1** to **65499**. The value of **FromPort** must be less than or equal to the value of **ToPort**.

description.zh: 待查询终端节点组映射信息配置的监听ID。
description.en: The ID of the listener for which you want to query endpoint group destination configurations.
The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
终端节点组后端服务的协议类型。取值：

- **TCP**：TCP协议。

- **UDP**：UDP协议。

- **TCP,UDP**：TCP和UDP协议。

为空时查询所有协议类型。

您最多可输入10个协议信息。
description.en:
The protocol type of the backend service of the endpoint group. Valid values:

- **TCP**: TCP protocol.

- **UDP**: UDP protocol.

- **TCP,UDP**: TCP and UDP protocols.

If this parameter is left empty, all protocol types are queried.

You can specify up to 10 protocol entries.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

description.zh:
终端节点组后端服务结束端口。

取值范围：**1**~**65499**，且需满足**FromPort**≤**ToPort**，即终端节点组后端服务起始端口需小于等于终端节点组后端服务结束端口。
description.en:
The end port of the backend service of the endpoint group.

Valid values: **1** to **65499**. The value of **FromPort** must be less than or equal to the value of **ToPort**.

title.zh: 查询终端节点组的映射信息配置列表
title.en: Query destination configurations of an endpoint group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoint-group-destinations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp16jdc00bhe97sr50000 --protocols TCP --from-port 80 --to-port 80 --region cn-hangzhou
